 UND Football Senior Linebacker Ethan Boll Previews Saturday’s Game Against Southern Illinois
 By Alex Carmenaty 
 Nov 20, 2026 | 11:17 AM 
 (KNOX) – The No. 10 ranked UND football team will host Southern Illinois on Saturday in the team’s regular season finale. The Fighting Hawks are 7-4 this season, with a 4-3 record in MVFC play, and are coming off their bye week. UND last played on November 7, when they defeated Illinois State 49-21. 
 Senior linebacker Ethan Boll is one of 19 seniors on the roster. This Saturday is also Senior Day, and he will be one of the many players recognized for their time with the team. The Crookston native says he will embrace Saturday one play at a time.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-1.wav 
 With the team coming off its bye week, Boll explains what the week was like for the team and how they avoided becoming complacent.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-2.wav 
 Southern Illinois is 5-6 this season, with a 3-4 MVFC record. With more time to prepare for SIU, Boll says the Fighting Hawks need to get off to another fast start.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-3.wav 
 With the FCS playoffs starting next week, UND has a chance to earn a first-round bye if it secures a top-eight seed in the national tournament. A win on Saturday could help the team achieve that goal. Boll says the team has a simple approach heading into Saturday’s game.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-4.wav 
 Boll has recorded 44 solo tackles, 71 total tackles, 5.5 tackles for loss, and 2.5 sacks. After playing primarily on special teams during his sophomore year and receiving more defensive opportunities last season, Boll says he has remained committed to the process of becoming the best player possible.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-5.wav 
 Boll also says that not playing right away can come with benefits in the long run.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-6.wav 
 As Boll went through the development process, one of his former teammates became an important mentor to him.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-7.wav 
 Having been close with Malachi McNeal, Boll also explains how he has built relationships with his current teammates and found success alongside them on the defense this year.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-8.wav 
 The Fighting Hawks have not lost at home this season, going 5-0 at the Alerus Center in 2026. Boll credits the fanbase for helping the team perform so well in front of its home crowd.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-9.wav 
 Regardless of how the rest of the season goes, Boll has a simple message for the fans and supporters of UND football.
 https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/2404/files/2026/11/boll-10.wav 
 UND will play SIU on Saturday at 1pm.
